description: Check that an Open Knowledge Format (OKF) bundle is conformant with the v0.2 spec (§11). Use when asked to validate, lint, or check an OKF bundle, or before committing changes to one. Runs a deterministic Python checker — not an eyeball pass. Also migrates a v0.1 bundle to v0.2 in place with `--migrate`.
